summary:

Pre-seeded paper 00cd048d flow: paper.sections non-empty, PDF endpoint returns 610KB %PDF (multi-page), downloads has matching question_paper entry with ref_id, POST /regenerate {q_no:'1'} → status:regenerating → after polling Q1 text CHANGED vs before, POST /new-set returns new id with set_no>=2. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, alice@bachein.com): /ai/question-paper setup form renders all chips (qp-board, qp-year, qp-class, qp-subject — Science visible on class 10, Physics/Chemistry visible on class 11, qp-diff, qp-sets), Generate tap shows qp-generating with progress bar + BacheinAiLogo and stage text polled through 3 unique stages within 30s. /ai/answer-paper paste-mode with 3-question text → ap-generating → completed in ~16s → EXAMINER TOTAL card (4 marks/3 answers), JUMP TO QUESTION chips Q1/Q2/Q3, per-answer green ✓ ticks and step ticks, +1/+0.5 award badges per step, examiner remarks, ap-download button all visible. /editor picker shows import-doc-btn + start-editor-btn + title-input; opening editor shows editor-screen with images-btn in header; tapping images-btn opens modal with insert-position-btn + auto-insert-images-btn; tapping insert-position-btn closed modal and showed 'Placeholder Image Position 1 inserted' toast confirming the insert action fires. /downloads screen renders all recent Question Paper + Answer Booklet entries created during this run.

react_native_issues.issue: On the Expo web preview, react-native-pell-rich-editor renders 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' inside the editor body (WebView is native-only). The toolbar and side actions render fine, and the 'Insert image position' toast + placeholder flow still fires (toast shown), but the actual `[Image Position N]` string cannot be visually verified inside the editor body via the web preview. This is a well-known react-native-webview limitation on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx:314 (RichEditor). NOT blocking on native mobile — will render correctly there.

action_items: No blocking fixes needed — all 11 review items pass.

Optional: consider swapping react-native-pell-rich-editor for a web-compatible fallback (e.g. TipTap/ProseMirror via a small platform-split) so that the rich editor is usable in the web preview too. Currently the toolbar works but the content area is dead on web. Not a native-mobile bug.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_workspace.py QP background job (_generate_paper_task) writes progress + progress_pct at each blueprint/section step — polling UX is correct; failed jobs set status:'failed' with truncated error, so the client can surface it. Regen sets status back to 'ready' even on regen error (line 835) which is intentional so the user can retry without losing the paper — flagged as design decision, not a bug.
downloads_routes.py correctly projects out pdf_b64 in list_downloads (line 18) so the /downloads listing stays lightweight — good.
editor_import handles TXT/DOCX/PDF and returns HTML with escaped text; DOCX table extraction is capped at 10 tables × 30 rows which is sensible. Invalid extension → 400 as expected.
QP disclaimer text is now exactly 'AI can make mistake, please check important info.' as required (ai_workspace.py:778, :1071) — verified in both /question-paper and /answer-paper POST responses.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest — QP options, QP create+poll, QP ready ops incl. regenerate+new-set, Answer paper full flow incl. PDF+downloads, Editor import txt/docx/invalid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 review items — setup form chips, class 10↔11 subject switch, generate→qp-generating progress with 3 unique stages, answer paper paste→ap-generating→ready with EXAMINER TOTAL/jump chips/ticks/badges/remarks/download, editor picker+screen+images modal+placeholder toast, downloads listing)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 new question_paper record (CBSE Class 10 Science Set 1 2025-26 — still generating when test finished), 1 new question_paper set (set_no>=2 via /new-set), 1 answer_paper (5-question Class 10 Science mini paper). Regenerate call on pre-seeded paper 00cd048d-a632-4370-9cca-f0ab9b66a407 has replaced its Q1 text with a new generated question (not restored). Reuse-safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite: /app/backend/tests/test_phase457_v2.py. Reuses pre-seeded paper id 00cd048d-a632-4370-9cca-f0ab9b66a407 (alice) for ready-state ops (PDF, downloads listing, regenerate, new-set). QP creation is a background _asyncio.create_task — POST returns immediately, then GET polls status:generating|regenerating|ready|failed with progress + progress_pct. Answer paper generation is fast in this backend (LLM ~11s for 5 questions). Disclaimer string must remain EXACT: 'AI can make mistake, please check important info.'. Frontend testIDs: /ai/question-paper → qp-screen, qp-board-*, qp-year-*, qp-class-*, qp-subject-*, qp-diff-*, qp-sets-*, qp-chapters, qp-generate, qp-generating, qp-regen-sec-{i}, qp-regen-q-{q_no}. /ai/answer-paper → ap-screen, ap-mode-upload/paste, ap-pick-file, ap-paste-input, ap-subject/class/board, ap-detail-*, ap-generate, ap-generating, ap-new, ap-download, ap-jump-{q_no}. /editor picker → editor-picker, type-*, title-input, start-editor-btn, import-doc-btn. /editor screen → editor-screen, editor-back, title-inline, images-btn, invite-btn, export-btn, ai-cmd-input, ai-run-btn, insert-position-btn, auto-insert-images-btn. NOTE: rich-editor content body cannot be introspected on web preview (WebView not supported on web) — verify insert-position by observing toast 'Placeholder Image Position N inserted' instead.
